## Summary / 概述

What does this change do and why is it needed? / 这次改动做了什么，为什么需要？

## Type of change / 改动类型

- [ ] Bug fix / 缺陷修复
- [ ] Feature / 新功能
- [ ] Docs / 文档
- [ ] Refactor or chore / 重构或杂项

## Checklist / 检查

- [ ] I have tested or described how to verify this change. / 我已测试，或说明了如何验证。
- [ ] I have not committed secrets, `.env` files with real values, or build artifacts. / 未提交密钥、含真实配置的 `.env` 或构建产物。
- [ ] Docs are updated when needed. / 如有必要已更新文档。
